title: Layers at a contact

doesNotKnow: The stipulated sequence includes B, but the exposure shows A directly below C across an erosional surface. That contact can mark missing time locally; the diagram alone does not date the gap.

misconception: The first apparent interpretation is the only possible one.
objective: A sequence is known to have layers A, B and C. At one exposure A and C meet across an erosion surface and B is missing. What can the contact represent?

claims.text: A sequence is known to have layers A, B and C. At one exposure A and C meet across an erosion surface and B is missing. What can the contact represent?
